decisions.novelty_explanation: NOVEL — The existing code prioritizes particles by personal-best rank. The proposed code assigns every particle equal priority, leaving retention to tie-breaking. This changes the selection strategy and can affect optimizer performance.

NOVEL: The existing code prioritizes particles by personal-best rank. The proposed code instead favors particles with smaller normalized distance to the best and lower normalized speed. This changes the retention criterion and can select different particles, affecting search behavior.

**NOVEL**: The existing code prioritizes particles by personal-best rank. The proposed code instead favors smaller projected distances, calculated from normalized relative position plus velocity scaled by 0.73. This changes the retention strategy and can select different particles.

**NOVEL**: The existing code scores distance at the end of a damped inertial step; the proposed code scores RMS distance over the entire trajectory. This changes how distance, speed, and alignment affect priority and can produce different particle rankings. It also adds alignment clamping and numerical scaling for stability.
